entries.name: Synthesis workshop and unlock sets
entries.summary: 33 recipes in six sets; unlocks count different products.
entries.instructions: Seal Agrabah to learn Green Trinity, place Sora, Donald and Goofy in the party, and activate the green mark inside Traverse Town's Accessory Shop. Climb the ladder to the Moogles. Set I starts available; sets II, III, IV and V require 3, 9, 15 and 21 distinct crafted products. Set VI requires all 30 earlier products. Crafting the same product repeatedly does not advance the distinct-product gate. The 15-product milestone also gives Encounter Plus. Finding an item elsewhere does not count as crafting it.

entries.name: Dream weapon and experience choices
entries.summary: Chosen weapon, sacrificed weapon and EXP curve are three separate decisions.
entries.instructions: At Dive to the Heart, your chosen Dream weapon controls Sora's ability order. The sacrificed weapon affects starting stats; it does not replace the chosen-weapon ability schedule. Choosing the Rod provides an extra starting MP and a higher eventual MP total. The later Tidus/Selphie/Wakka questions set Dawn, Midday or Dusk EXP growth; the first responses give Dawn, the middle responses Midday and the last responses Dusk. Dawn gains early levels faster, Dusk needs less total EXP for level 100. These choices are fixed for that save. See each ability for all three Final Mix level unlocks.

entries.name: Experience thresholds and leveling
entries.summary: All 99 level increases, chosen-weapon rewards and complete Sora/party EXP curves.
entries.instructions: Dawn requires less EXP in the early game; Dusk requires the least total EXP for level 100. The full level entries give cumulative thresholds and each individual level cost for all three Sora curves, Donald, Goofy and the guest party members. Values agree between the complete Final Mix guide and documented vanilla battle-table increments. For practical grinding, replay Rock Titan after unlocking Hades opponent selection, or farm Ice Titan Tech EXP with Guard and Tech Boost. Disable EXP Zero to gain EXP.

entries.name: Bambi material farming
entries.summary: Fill Bambi's gauge by defeating enemies during the summon; the world determines the drop family.
entries.instructions: Summon Bambi with 1 MP during ordinary combat. Enemy defeats charge his gauge; his generated MP prizes support continued magic. The first fill guarantees Potion, the second Ether, and the third Hi-Potion in Final Mix. Material rolls depend on both world and gauge-fill count. End of the World, not Traverse Town, supplies Mythril: 20% Mythril Shard at fill two, then 20% Mythril Shard and 10% Mythril at fill three. Many Final Mix special enemies do not charge the gauge. Each linked world row lists the exact conditional material rolls.

coverage.notes: 33 distinct products; sets 6/6/6/6/6/3. Energy Bangle reconciled to 2 Spirit Shards using independent KHGuides and dedicated item source. Three Stars corrected to 5 Power Gems. Source-backed, no gameplay verification.

coverage.label: Synthesis materials and farming
coverage.notes: All 34 ingredients, ordinary sources, ten special encounters, and all nine Bambi world/gauge reward tables. Membership complete; no hands-on verification.

coverage.label: Obtainable party weapons
coverage.notes: 18 Keyblades, 15 staves, 15 shields. Explicit Final Mix strength/MP overrides replace mixed-version legacy stats; prices and shop gates included.

coverage.label: Accessory catalog
coverage.notes: All accessories from the KH 1/FM source roster; Final Mix stat overrides applied. Acquisition entries emphasize synthesis/shop/unique reward; every alternative chest is linked through the collectible catalog where available. Three Stars Defense remains an explicit +3/+4 source conflict; roster and recipes are complete.

coverage.label: Acquisition-relevant enemies
coverage.notes: All 44 acquisition-relevant enemy records include practical farming rooms, source world appearances, field-phase HP/Strength/Defense/EXP, effectiveness and Final Mix reward tables. Shadow has 13 world/phase rows. Cup populations/variants are separate records; an exhaustive room-by-room spawn manifest is not claimed.

coverage.label: Abilities and chosen-weapon unlocks
coverage.notes: 65 abilities with AP costs, chosen Sword/Shield/Rod unlocks, party-member unlock clauses and movement abilities; complete 99 level Sora reward matrix links matching abilities. HD Combo Master is Sword 50, Shield 55, Rod 55.

coverage.label: Sora level rewards and complete party EXP curves
coverage.notes: 99 Sora level rewards for all three chosen weapons; exact full Dawn/Midday/Dusk, Donald, Goofy and six-guest EXP curves. Complete guide agrees with sums of documented vanilla battle-table increments. HD Combo Master overlay is included. No hands-on verification; party stat gains are outside this matrix.
